case.summary: Customer C08106 reported an unrecognized online transaction of $128.33 (ID 3583227) on card C08106-K1. The purchase was made via device D001477, which was flagged as New for the account, and the cardholder baseline revealed no matching recurring charges or prior baseline history. Additionally, card C08106-K1 has three prior confirmed card-not-present fraud cases, and the cardholder reaffirmed their denial upon follow-up. Based on the customer dispute and device novelty, the transaction was determined to be fraudulent under the card_not_present_new_device pattern with 0.97 probability, and the card was blocked.
